Assumptions are explicit: S nonempty, unique nonzero generators, ell(s)=1, any dimension d>=1; no connectivity requirement. value.rationale: For arbitrary bipartite Boolean Cayley graphs, including high-degree connected examples and disconnected or dependent-generator cases, the theorem gives the entire exact strong-odd chromatic number, not an isolated arithmetic recomputation. The odd-fiber lemma furnishes an explicit optimal coordinate coloring and the square-zero argument gives a sharp obstruction. The Hamming-distance-shell corollary yields a natural two-parameter classification beyond the already-known r=1 hypercube case; no downstream theorem is required for a motivated infinite structural classification.
